|strategy=By [mailto:briank@decipher.com Brian Kallenbach]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020612225158/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/afewmaneuvers.html</ref>

The most important use of this card is one of the simplest in the game. It is a destiny 6 and a widely usable Used Interrupt. This means that you may almost always play this interrupt, even if you don't need it, simply to get that 6 destiny back into your deck. It is also a helpful interrupt if your opponent plans on using [[Tractor Beam]] to snare one of your ships. [[A Few Maneuvers]] can through off that destiny draw, and can be played after your opponent targets you.

Combos:

[[A Few Maneuvers]] + [[Kessel Run]] -- [[A Few Maneuvers]] adds to the starship's hyperspeed, increasing the speed with which you can make a [[Kessel Run]], especially when you're making a long distance run, say, from [[Kessel]] to [[Corellia]].
|combos=* [[A Few Maneuvers]] + [[Kessel Run]] Increase your starship's hyperspeed to make a long-distance run (from [[Kessel]] to [[Corellia]] for example).<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=A%20Few%20Maneuvers Scomp Link Access: A Few Maneuvers], scomp.starwarsccg.org.
